title: Venture Capital and Private M&A Contracting

rival_explanations: VCs reduce earnouts by influencing negotiation power / bargaining strength rather than by mitigating information asymmetry
earnouts are used to address moral hazard (incentivizing key employees/founders) rather than information asymmetry
regulatory-based earnouts address third-party regulatory decision uncertainty (FDA approval) rather than insider information asymmetry, so VCs should have no effect on them
